axes.concept: A working archive of balloon installations: each named scene is a live folded record with its owner and saved revision.
axes.layout: Full-width stacked records unfold in place into an asymmetric scene/details spread; no global sidebar, dashboard tiles or preview-card grid.
axes.navigation: An in-flow collection underline, server-collection search and authorized owner filter lead into keyboard-operated record disclosures; project-local return and recovery actions stay beside the project title.
axes.typography: Arial/Helvetica offline product fallback: 32px page title, 21/23px record names, 24px fold and conflict titles, 14–15px controls, 12px tabular monospace timestamps.
axes.density: Compact 91px desktop records with 24px unfolding gutters; phone records use two rows with a 23px name. Flat rules carry dense ownership/revision data; rounded frames are reserved for scene diagrams, controls and modal decisions.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, Animate UI Dialog and AlertDialog, Skeleton; custom folded record, schematic installation, version spread and import receipt. Native planning selectors and owner filter.
axes.colour: Pictures tokens mapped to shadcn roles: pale violet background/neutral ink in light, near-black/white ink in dark, mauve action, green saved state and amber conflict. Stronger local input edges and dark metadata prevent low contrast.
axes.motion: Precise folio choreography: 9px horizontal registration, 45ms record sequencing, -4deg perspective fold to flat, and two version sheets collating 80ms apart. Expressive cut 420ms/fold 588ms, natural 220/308ms, subtle 140/196ms; .16,1,.3,1 easing. Buttons settle in 160ms. Reduced motion/still=1 preserve the final content without travel.
